title: Panshi IntroductionReadyReceiptBodyV1
description: TBody of IntroductionReadyReceiptV1 = CrossContextReceiptEnvelopeV1<IntroductionReadyReceiptBodyV1> (system-design.md §8.2, sealed in the same transaction that moves an Introduction into READY_FOR_ACTIVATION). The source spec prose lists these fields in snake_case (introduction_id, character_id, command_admission_body_digest, command_accepted_at, origin_digest, model_core_assignment_digest, asset_pack_digest, capacity_reservation_id, quota_window_id, policy_revision_set, rights_snapshot_refs, ready_at); this schema normalizes casing to camelCase for consistency with the other two receipt bodies in this contract family. This body is produced only after ALL age, real-person-similarity, content, rights, identity, asset, capacity, and schema business gates have already passed, and it never contains its own envelope's bodyDigest, signature, append position, event ID/hash, or any other provenance field.

introductionId.description: camelCase of source spec's introduction_id. The durable Introduction state-machine ID this ready receipt belongs to.

characterId.description: camelCase of source spec's character_id. Only meaningful once CharacterOriginSealed has already fixed the character's life.

commandAdmissionBodyDigest.description: camelCase of source spec's command_admission_body_digest. The bodyDigest of the CommandAdmissionReceiptBodyV1 that admitted this introduction's AdmitAuthoringCommand; the sole cross-reference into that receipt (never re-fetched or re-derived).

commandAcceptedAt.description: camelCase of source spec's command_accepted_at. Copied verbatim from the referenced CommandAdmissionReceiptBodyV1.commandAcceptedAt -- the single server DB-transaction time that determines this introduction's quota window and authoring-window membership. Never re-sampled at ready time.

originDigest.description: camelCase of source spec's origin_digest. Digest of the sealed CharacterOriginSealed origin blob.

modelCoreAssignmentDigest.description: camelCase of source spec's model_core_assignment_digest. Digest of the ModelCoreAssigned assignment record.

assetPackDigest.description: camelCase of source spec's asset_pack_digest. Digest of the qualified minimum CharacterAssetPack (identity master, avatar, safe crop, rig bundle, VoiceIdentityProfileV1, and their qualification record).

capacityReservationId.description: camelCase of source spec's capacity_reservation_id. The population/continuity capacity reservation this introduction consumed to enter the birth/asset pipeline.

quotaWindowId.description: camelCase of source spec's quota_window_id. Echoes the same Asia/Taipei ISO quota window ID fixed by the referenced CommandAdmissionReceiptBodyV1; never recomputed.

policyRevisionSet.description: camelCase of source spec's policy_revision_set. Ordered, de-duplicated list of every policy revision identifier (age/real-person-similarity/content/rights/identity/asset/schema gates, etc.) that this introduction was validated against before reaching READY_FOR_ACTIVATION. The source spec lists only the bare field name; this schema documents the inferred shape (array of opaque revision identifier strings) rather than inventing new field names.

rightsSnapshotRefs.description: camelCase of source spec's rights_snapshot_refs. Ordered, de-duplicated list of immutable rights-snapshot artifact references consulted for this introduction. Inferred shape (array of opaque reference strings) documented here since the source spec lists only the bare field name.

readyAt.description: camelCase of source spec's ready_at. The server DB-transaction time this introduction entered READY_FOR_ACTIVATION and this body was sealed. Not a wall-clock expiry.
